# Checkbox
Independent on/off choice, or a tri-state parent of a group.

**When to use** — opting into terms, multi-select lists, a "select all" parent row.
**When not to** — an immediate setting that applies on toggle (Switch), or one-of-many (no Radio exists — log a candidate).

<!-- BEGIN:generated-structure -->

## Variants
`default` box plus label · `card` whole surface is the target, for selectable options

## Sizes
`sm` dense lists · `md` default · `lg` 24px box, touch-first screens

<!-- END:generated-structure -->

## Do
- Use `checked="indeterminate"` on a parent whose children are partly selected.
- Pass `label`; without one, supply `aria-label`.
- Set `invalid` with a visible error for required agreements.

## Don't
- Don't use a Checkbox to apply a change immediately — that reads as a Switch.
- Don't nest checkboxes visually without wiring the parent's indeterminate state.

```tsx
<Checkbox label="Email me receipts" description="Sent after every transfer" />
<Checkbox variant="card" label="Standard delivery" checked={v} onCheckedChange={setV} />
```
